reviews.title: Concerns
reviews.text:
I’ve had the sock since April and never had an issue up to last week! 
It keeps disconnecting from the wifi and then once I have reconnected it it can’t find the sock. My sons crib is next to me and the bedside cabinet so his sock is within a meter of the base. 
I rely on the base heavily due to impaired vision especially at night as I cannot visually see my son unless I turn a light on and put my glasses on. 
This is not good for my mental health diagnosis! 

I have emailed and awaiting a response. 

It is a lot of money and with the subscription on top you would expect it to work fine still especially within six months of purchase!!

reviews.title: Fantastic product with terrible inconsistencies
reviews.text: For how expensive of a product this is it should be the easiest thing to setup and the easiest thing to maintain a connection on (both of which it is not). When it works it gives tremendous peace of mind but the key is IF it works. It took 2 days just to get it setup because of the gymnastics we had to do to get it connected to our wifi. We had to change our actual home wifi name as well as do some additional router settings switches just to get a connection started. Once it’s connected there’s no rhyme or reason to when it’ll decide to disconnect on you. I’d say roughly 10ish times per day the base station randomly decides to disconnect from the wifi and the only solution is to repeatedly connect and disconnect the base station while spam swiping into and out of the app. I’d absolutely give this 5 stars if it worked flawlessly, and 3 stars if it was cheaper, but the fact that it is as expensive as it is and has all these issues gets it a 1 star. Honestly for the peace of mind it’s given my wife and I when it does decide to work we still think it’s worth it to have even with these issues, but just to let others know you’re gonna end up running into a lot of issues with this product.

reviews.title: Dangerous Reliability Issue! Frozen Video With No Warning!
reviews.text:
We trusted this device completely to monitor our baby’s safety. That trust is now gone.

During a nap, the Owlet camera froze while displaying an image of our baby peacefully sleeping. There was absolutely no warning, notification, or indication that the video and audio feed had stopped working.

Meanwhile, our baby had woken up and was crying, and we had no idea. The monitor continued showing her sound asleep, giving us a completely false sense of security.

It wasn’t until we physically heard her crying from her room that we rushed in and discovered what had happened. We have no idea how long she had been awake and crying. Even after picking her up and bringing her out of the room, the Owlet monitor was STILL displaying the frozen image of her sleeping.

This is an absolutely unacceptable failure for a product marketed to parents for monitoring their children.

If a camera loses its connection, experiences transmission issues, or the video feed freezes, there MUST be an immediate, unmistakable alert notifying parents that the feed is no longer live. Continuing to display a frozen image as though everything is functioning normally is dangerously misleading.

Parents purchase these devices because they trust them to help keep their children safe. A monitor that silently freezes while making parents believe their child is peacefully sleeping is worse than a monitor that clearly disconnects.

Technical glitches happen. Failing to notify parents that their monitor is no longer f

reviews.title: Good but needs multiple bug fixes
reviews.text:
We have been using this app since our daughter was born in May. For the most part it works as it should but we have noticed a few irritating bugs. 
1. When you receive a notification for sound/motion detection, once that is clicked on and the Owlet app opens back up, the camera feed will not display. The red light on the camera turns on as if it is actively recording but in the app, the loading circle just spins forever. Both my husband and I have to close out the app and open it back up for the camera feed to display. This is quite annoying to do because I should be able to click on the motion detection notification and it show the camera feed 
2. If you are viewing the live camera footage while wearing headphones/airpods and click on the mic to turn it on and talk, it automatically shuts off the sound on the app while you’re talking. Totally fine except when you turn the mic off and the sound back on, it plays through the phone speakers not your headphones/airpods.

reviews.title: Constant app issues, but we love the sock
reviews.text: Yet another update, yet another thing that isn’t working correctly now. Someone do a beta testing app before releasing to the actual app! Constant camera connectivity issues (we have been using this for 3+ years, we’ve done all the troubleshooting, save your breath), a couple of months ago after an update all of a sudden the sound went completely awful on the cameras and it has to be turned all the way up and now everything sounds garbled (yes, we’ve tried two different cameras, and in multiple locations/homes), that has never resolved, videos only viewable for 24hrs without a subscription (BS), and now the latest update, the Picture in Picture function has gone completely black and doesn’t work anymore. The sock gave us peace of mind, and we love it, (for ppl who complain about false alarms with the sock, learn to put it in correctly and use socks or footie pj’s - I have the most restless child and we have had minimal issues), but good god, the camera and app issues have been a constant source of irritation. We have a basic sound monitor as backup because we can’t trust the app/camera to stay connected throughout the night. Every “bug fix and performance enhancement” update released seems to create more issues than whatever it was they were trying to “fix”. Updates need to be tested before being pushed, that clearly is NOT happening.

reviews.text: The sleep schedule is automatically set for 7pm-7am and gives the option to edit it but no matter what I do it automatically turns back to 7pm immediately.. my baby doesn’t sleep at 7pm she sleeps typically 10:00pm-11pm so every night her sleep is labeled as “restless” because it’s not counting 7 hours of her sleep! It’s so frustrating. I’ve reach out to the help line before but it’s just a AI chat bot that doesn’t understand what the issue is and won’t help, it gives unresolved advice by linking a random help page but isn’t related to what I’m talking about

reviews.title: Frustrating
reviews.text:
Have just updated the app ‘bug fixes’ said the update. It’s now not displaying any of my child’s stats and data - heart rate, oxygen etc. 

After the last update it stopped allowing me to view video footage. 


The is my second owlet sock and cam. I wrote to the company after the previous one failed after 18 months or so use. The reply was essentially - tough. For a fairly costly product I expect better. 
Unfortunately I begrudgingly paid out again £££ for peace of mind. 

Good idea but too glitchy.  Customer service was not good on my most recent interactions.

reviews.title: Pointless & abysmal customer services
reviews.text: I cannot connect the products (cam 2 or sock) to my wifi - customer services is possibly the worst ever experienced in any company as I get a pointless and unhelpful response usually 2 days later at 1am in the morning… no efforts to contact me or help me & if if it wasn’t for the brand id think this was a scam company. My baby will be fully grown before they actually help at this rate….

reviews.title: Terrible Installation User Interface
reviews.text:
The process of setting up a Device on Owlet Dream is the absolute worst experience I've ever had with a device. For such a premium expensive product, absolutely no thought has been put into the user experience. 

Why isn't the QR Code on the camera to scan with our devices? Trying to get the Cam 2 to find the QR code on my device was painful. 

However, when you do hear the chime that is only the start of your troubles. 

I've been waiting for 15 minutes while Cam 2 checks for updates. Is the app broken? Is it actually searching for updates? If so, why does it take so long when I have super fast broadband. 

The camera is about to be thrown out the window. 

Thank god I tried to set this up before my baby was born! I can't imagine dealing with this pain while also trying to care for a newborn.

reviews.title: Connecting to the cam is a nightmare
reviews.text: The sock is great. The QR code method of connecting to the cam 2 is diabolical. Please change it to a different method. Incredibly frustrating and time consuming and we have just given up.

reviews.title: Customer Service Absent
reviews.text: We had an issue connecting our dream sock to our wifi at home (for some reason it disconnected after we had been using for 2 months without issues), so I started a chat with their AI support which was not able to fix the problem so they transferred me to a real person. Vincent was initially pleasant and seemingly very eager to help - about 5 minutes later after he transferred me to an email chain and out of the chat, and long story short he eventually just ghosted me. I was not disrespectful and felt like I was being very cooperative following every instruction he was sending me but the issue was not being fixed and seemed to be getting worse as my dream sock then disconnected from the app entirely. I simply stated, word for word "this seems like i am only going backwards and is getting quite frustrating" - no cussing, no attacking, just calmly expressing my frustration as this was 11pm and I had been working on this now for over an hour between AI and Vincent. Vincent did not respond after that, I asked for a follow up to see what else I can try and the next day I still had no response. I am incredibly disappointed with their customer service - I would understand if I was being rude to him why he would ghost me like that, but given that wasn't the case it really got my gears grinding that for a product designed around baby safety that the support is so incredibly lacking . 0 stars for Vincent himself if I were able to do so. Shame on you Vincent and Owlet customer service fo

reviews.title: Doesn't work
reviews.text: £300 and won't even connect, had multiple issues and when I finally got it working the notifications don't alert on the app at all even though they're all turned on. Also saying wrong region? Waste of money for something so poorly done

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: The device constantly disconnects and requires a hard reboot that means I cannot trust it

reviews.title: Very bad design issues.
reviews.text: I purchased the camera first and after spending several minutes trying to connect it for the first time I put it back in the box and returned it. There’s absolutely no excuse in 2026 for something as simple as connecting a device over WiFi or Bluetooth to be so problematic. I mean Nest is not great, but usually takes me 5 minutes to have a camera online. Anyway, two months later I got the Dream sock as a present and the same thing happened, impossible to get the thing setup because it won’t connect to my home network or Bluetooth. A quick look at Reddit tells me this is a well known issue with Owlet products. I’m a  technical person and even for me troubleshooting this is a nightmare. I know if I invest the time I will eventually get it to work. But why? This is core, basic feature that should be pretty straightforward. Owlet should issue a recall. Something obviously went very wrong in the development of these products. Customer should not be blindsided like this into buying defective products.

reviews.title: Disconnects every day
reviews.text: The concept of the owlet sock and the app is great, however over the last week something has changed and now I have to delete my wifi and repair it again nightly for owlet to work. It’s an absolute nuisance and I pay the extra for Owler360, why?

reviews.title: Waste of money
reviews.text: App always has something wrong so the camera can’t be used and the sock disconnects from WiFi and won’t reconnect. Even with replacement cameras and base stations the app still doesn’t work. For the price it is not worth the hassle.

reviews.title: Listen to the bad reviews. Get something else
reviews.text:
Same problems as everyone else. I’m just waiting to re-install the app after another attempt to get the camera to work and I can’t believe how awful the reviews have been for such a long time.

I highly doubt they will acknowledge my request but I’m emailing them to request for a refund. For the cam. The sock works well in this moment in time (although it too was a nightmare at one point).

reviews.title: App not working on iPad
reviews.text: App not working on iPad tried to delete and reinstall and it won’t even let me log in. Not ideal when it’s the main way for watching both my babies - older app is doing the same too

reviews.title: Keep stopping connecting
reviews.text: The sock it’s a great idea, however every few days it stops connecting to my phone and recording the vital signs. Not very good if you have anxiety.

reviews.title: Great idea terrible app
reviews.text:
The sock itself and base station offer excellent reassurance and look slick and are easy to put on the child. The app and connecting to the WiFi is another story. Initially it was such a pain and so unnecessarily difficult to get it to work and connect to WiFi. The camera takes an AGE to load to stream
video and also just randomly cuts out and awkwardly crops the field of view when you do Picture in Picture, also it doesn’t send any notifications for sound or movement no matter how sensitive I make the settings, no clips have ever been recorded. I have purchased a different camera for this reason. The app is also slow and frequently disconnects. It’s also not very user friendly when you scrub along the sleep info the indicator is never in line with the time you’re actually on. Would purchase the sock, not the camera and the app needs a serious overhaul.

reviews.text: Not receiving confirmation email 👎

reviews.title: Setup is awful
reviews.text:
I download the app. Select join owlet. Fill out password and email to setup my account. Sends verification email and then displays won’t proceed until email is verified. Swap apps to email, click link, it stated congrats you are verified proceed in the app. Go back to app and it is back at square one. Click login get error, select join email already taken.
After fighting with it I found that if I leave the error on screen without hitting ok, it eventually loads in the background and says welcome to the family. Once that screen appeared I hit Ok and then proceeded with finishing my setup. 
One the setup started it sees my wireless network and I get notification that the device joined my network, from my wireless router, then the join process states failure. About an hour of troubleshooting and rebooting things I found the wireless reset for the owlet and that allowed me to connect. No where on the box does it state that this only works with 2.4GHz and I had a fear that this was potentially my issue. As a hardware product very behind the times as 5GHz has been out for a while and 6GHz is out now. 
Not the best experience for the amount of money that was just dropped to purchase this device.

reviews.title: Every parent should have this… but fix it before no one does
reviews.text:
I have twins. You sold me a product designed to monitor vitals and provide real time video.

It fails to do either in a useable way.

1. Video is delayed and in emergency every second counts. Fix this. No it’s not my WiFi. I have ring cameras in the same room. No delay. Fix it.

2. I have twins… I gave you. ALL THE MONEY to be able to do two things 1. Monitor vitals of BOTH MY KIDS SIMULTANEOUSLY 2. Have live video of both my kids simultaneously. Why in the world doesn’t your app support watching two videos and seeing two sets of vitals at the same time? I can watch two videos and get 1 vital or I can watch two vitals and get 1 video. But not both? 

Are you all reading these reviews since your last update?

Someone on the product team needs to be fired or someone in leadership needs to be fired bc you’re doing a poor job at running your business.

This is arguably one of the greatest and most important inventions in the history of infant care. But y’all are going to destroy the opportunity, market, customer faith and put yourselves out of business because you are FAILING on the commercial side.

Design better products, listen to your customers, fix features, push updates faster, tighten feedback loop, execute.  This is basic stuff.

If you can’t do it call me I’ll do bc you apparently can’t be trusted running a company. Child lives are at stake and you asked for the awesome responsibility to protect them. Do better.

reviews.title: Keeps breaking BUY EUFY INSTEAD
reviews.text:
EUFY IS THE EXACT SAME EXCEPT CHEAPER AND DOESNT BREAK!!
Lots of issues with the app including dropping the WiFi/ sock connection and not working for weeks at a time so not possible to see live readings. (I live in a small house the base station is never more than 4 metres from the WiFi box & sock) Also a new glitch is the app sticking on the dock is charging screen and no longer working. Disappointing app for such an expensive device. The older owlet care app never had this issue so budget costs were avoided in this app development

reviews.title: Could be great
reviews.text: Don’t get me wrong, I do love my owlet, it helps me sleep at night knowing my daughter is okay but the new (paid subscription) 360 feature doesn’t let you edit the schedule time away from 7pm-7am which means all the data Is inaccurate if your baby has a later sleep and wake time which is very disappointing. I did email and report it nearly 8 weeks ago and it was a known fault. Surely it should be fixed by now? There has been around 3~ updates since then and it’s still not fixed. Very frustrating, especially as an app specalising in baby sleep it should be a priority to fix as we all know not all babies sleep 7-7. So I’d avoid buying the sock and downloading the app if that’s not your child’s schedule.

reviews.title: Tremendous resource, terrible app
reviews.text:
For starters, it’s not completely fair to rate the product as a 1 star. The sock itself and the tech provided to get such amazing statistics on our babies sleep is incredible. We love that we can check in on the app and see that he’s congested just based off of oxygen levels. HOWEVER, genuinely one of the most infuriating apps me or my wife have ever dealt with. We have the emergency warnings turned on because we’re both deep sleepers. You think it would be a benefit, but it’s never a bonus, always a hindrance. This would apply whether we had emergency alerts on or off, because once it notifies you the sock isn’t getting proper readings, the app all but crashes itself waiting to get accurate readings. But I can pull down the notification and see proper, accurate readings when I’m swiping down on the notification. It still persists. The sock will be on, our baby will be asleep, we’ll be in the process of trying to get some sleep ourselves, but one thing remains… THE BEEPING OF 1000 SMOKE DETECTORS. It’s genuinely disappointing because it’s such a nice resource for peace of mind, but the app itself is bad enough we’ve discussed swapping to the cheaper eufy we purchased before receiving the owlet as a gift. 

Owlet, I beg of you, just fix the app, the sock itself is awesome.

reviews.title: Never worked properly
reviews.text: So many issues with the noise, camera and connection. Terrible customer service.

reviews.title: Will never recommend or buy again
reviews.text: I use both the camera and the sock and am disappointed by both. For products that are supposed to aid in peace of mind and security, these do the opposite. They are consistently inaccurate, unreliable and disruptive to the sleep of us as parents as well as our baby. First, the camera is constantly losing connection. And it’s not an issues with the internet because the sock will stay connected (as well as all other devices on the network). Additionally, there’s no easy way to trouble shoot the problem. The app sends you in circles without providing any helpful feed back. The app lags and the readings are almost never right (it currently is reading the nursery at 91°….the heat is set to 68° and is nowhere near 90). The sock is consistently inaccurate, I will be holding my baby that has been sound asleep for 15 minutes while the sock is reading as “awake”. Even worse, on more than one occasion we’ve been woken by “red” alerts only to run into the baby’s room and see her peacefully sleeping. This happened 3 times in a row one night, to the point that we were waking her to ensure she was ok (she was perfectly fine,’my husband is an EMT and checked her over). As new parents and an infant, getting a good nights sleep is vital to be able to function during the day and these products hinder that. If someone told me they wanted to buy either of these products, I would strongly advise against it. I hear great things about Nanit though.

reviews.title: When it’s good it’s good, when it’s bad… it’s awful
reviews.text: The sock itself is great and has given us unbelievable peace of mind. The camera however is horrendous. It barely connects, sometimes just sits for hours unable to show a feed. It cuts in and out consistently not giving live data. The app itself is so unbelievably slow, slow to open, slow to connect and most of the time is 10/30 seconds behind what’s actually happening, which is awful if you’re downstairs and unaware the baby has been crying for 30 seconds already. Could be so good, but for the price of it with Camera and sock?? Not worth it.

reviews.title: Fed up.
reviews.text:
Impossible to connect the cam2 to wifi unless you screenshot the QR code and show it on an iPad - yeah, do that if you struggle! Much bigger screen seems to do the trick.

I renamed my phone to the same wifi SSID and password as my home wifi so I never have to reconnect when we travel. Tricks the camera to connect when I turn on hotspot.

The state of the app is just unacceptable for this level of hardware and its purpose. We are facing one weird bug after another. Constantly. Finally got fed up when the app decided we didn’t have the camera and refused to show live feed. You know what helped? I renamed my camera in the settings using some descriptive adjectives.

If Owlet fixes the app, I can recommend but since the app is the only way to interact with the cam and sock to an extent too, frustration is just not worth it.

reviews.title: Mixed feelings
reviews.text:
I am writing to provide detailed feedback regarding my experience with an Owlet camera device purchased in 2023. While we rely on this device, the current performance issues are severely impacting its usability and do not align with the product's price point.
Key Issues
• App Instability and Loading: The mobile application frequently fails to load content, requiring a force-close and relaunch almost every time the app is accessed. This significantly hinders timely access to the live camera feed.
• Inconsistent Notifications: We are experiencing an inconsistent notification issue where only one user (myself) is reliably receiving motion alerts on their phone, while my husband's device does not receive them despite correct setup.
• Motion Detection and Recording Failure: Recently, the device has stopped reliably detecting motion and is failing to record events, which defeats the primary purpose of the security camera.
• Recurring Technical Problems: We have previously contacted customer support regarding performance issues. The solution provided—a factory reset—only offers a temporary fix, with the same critical problems reappearing within a few months

The recurring nature of these issues suggests a potential flaw in the product's long-term quality or software stability. Given that this camera was purchased in 2023, the frequency of these issues is concerning and makes me question the expected lifespan of the device.

reviews.title: Positive hardware - awful software
reviews.text:
The hardware in concept is good and why we chose owlet — the cameras and socks are great, when they work. But, having twins, we’ve had to replace the sock sensor for each child barely 1 year after their birth. While the process to replace them was fairly straightforward, the fact this was necessary for both children while using the socks for their intended purpose is ridiculous. The cameras are arguably worse. Many times the cameras simply will not connect over and over and over, regardless of the amount of of times you force close the app and reopen it, for no good reason. The reliability of the cameras is shoddy at best, which is incredibly frustrating. And most recently, every time we have opened the app, it gives an intrusive pop up for feedback, no matter the amount of times we have either provided feedback or dismissed the pop up altogether. 

FIX IT! It is incredibly annoying at this point, on top of the issues listed this review. If we weren’t so deep into an ecosystem that isn’t cheap to get into, I would have already looked at another company’s products.

reviews.title: Glitchy unresponsive app
reviews.text: Any time the baby moves, owlet will have a difficulty getting readings, raising the yellow alarm. That's understandable. What is unacceptable at this price point is when I try to turn off the alarm from my phone- the app takes too long to open the alarm screen where it can be silenced. Sometimes I have to close and open the app a few times for the alarm screen to open up. All this while the alarm in base station is going off loudly. You can get up and turn off the alarm from base station, but if baby is napping/feeding on you then it is extra trouble. For us, we also have another kid at home, and the alarm going off loudly every time for several minutes due to unresponsive app also wakes him up. And no, paying customer, who also happen to be new parents with already enough things to do should not have to email you with feedback to improve your app. This is the platform where we are giving you feedback. Maybe hire a project manager to collect feedback rather than having your customers do your job.

reviews.title: Annoying pop-up
reviews.text: The app keeps asking me to rate it EVERY TIME I open it. I have to manually close the pop-up every time I open the app.
